# Extract results for ko and ja
import json
out={}
for lang in ['ko','ja']:
    url=f"https://www.imdb.com/search/title/?title_type=feature&release_date=2015-01-01,2024-12-31&user_rating=7.0,&num_votes=10000,&runtime=,130&primary_language={lang}&sort=user_rating,desc"
    goto_url(url); wait_for_load(); time.sleep(3)
    # click "50 more" until gone
    for i in range(10):
        r=js("""(()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>/more|plus/i.test(b.innerText)&&b.className.includes('ipc-see-more'));if(b){b.click();return true}return false})()""")
        if not r: break
        time.sleep(3)
    items=js("""(()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('li.ipc-metadata-list-summary-item')].map(li=>{const a=li.querySelector('a.ipc-title-link-wrapper');return {t:a.innerText,h:a.href.split('?')[0],txt:li.innerText.split('\\n').slice(0,6).join('|')}}))()""")
    out[lang]=items
    print(lang,len(items), js("document.body.innerText.match(/\\d+-\\d+ (sur|of) \\d+/)?.[0]"))
json.dump(out,open('~/.hermes/profiles/voyagerbrowser/cache/scratch/res.json','w'))
